Uttar Pradesh Leads India in Milk Production, Sets New Record

Uttar Pradesh has achieved the top position in milk production nationwide, producing a record 38.8 million metric tons. This achievement was highlighted during a conclave celebrating the golden jubilee of the Dairy Department. The state's success is attributed to initiatives like the Nand Baba Milk Mission.
